principle: the bias degrades fail-open for notification context and fail-closed only for the entry gate

scenarios.scenario: 4H data fetch failure at the service boundary (getFourHourCandles throws)
scenarios.behaviour: snapshot(null, 'UNAVAILABLE', ..., errorView('DATA')) is published and replaces the previous current snapshot

scenarios.scenario: no fully closed native 4H candle available
deterministic fact calculation failure (INSUFFICIENT_WARMUP, NON_FUTURES_4H_DATA, FOUR_HOUR_DATA_GAP, NON_FINITE_FACT_*, STRUCTURE_FUTURE_CONFIRMATION, ...)
scenarios.behaviour: UNAVAILABLE with stage FACT_BUILD and the original error code; no LLM call
UNAVAILABLE with stage DECISION_IDENTITY (facts are retained on the snapshot)
UNAVAILABLE; emits 4H_BIAS_DECISION_STORE_CORRUPT; the record is never regenerated or overwritten

scenarios.scenario: DeepSeek timeout / network error / empty 200 / non-JSON / schema-invalid response
scenarios.behaviour: snapshot(latest.closeTime, 'PARTIAL', factSet.facts, null, errorView('SEMANTIC')) - the deterministic facts are retained and published, semantic is null

scenarios.scenario: DeepSeek client fails synchronously (for example MISSING_API_KEY)
scenarios.behaviour: the call is wrapped in Promise.resolve().then(...) so a synchronous throw also degrades to PARTIAL rather than escaping
rejects with V3_MODEL_CONFIG_MISMATCH, which the catch turns into PARTIAL

scenarios.scenario: decision store write failure after a successful LLM call
scenarios.behaviour: biasFailureStage = DECISION_STORE -> UNAVAILABLE; the ephemeral decision is never published as if it were durable
the error is swallowed and logged with the explicit note '(不影响 EQ/FVG/WATCH/notification)'; the tick continues

scenarios.scenario: HTF incremental fetch failure (1h/4h/1d network error or degraded source)
scenarios.behaviour: if (!htf.ok) { log(...); return; } - the tick returns before dataSource.pollNew5m, so the whole 5m pipeline is paused for that tick
scenarios.nextTickRecovery: the next tick retries the HTF increment; after recovery the gap is detected and backfilled so Live and Replay stay consistent

keyDistinction: the 4H CANDLE data pipeline is a shared HTF dependency of the whole 5m tick (and therefore an accidental coupling), while the 4H BIAS semantic decision is deliberately isolated from the 5m pipeline

fiveMinutePipelineGateDetail.code: if (!htf.ok) { log(symbol + ' HTF 更新异常（' + htf.issues.length + ' 处）——本轮暂停 5m 推进，避免基于 stale HTF 发通知'); return; }
fiveMinutePipelineGateDetail.affectedScope: per symbol, per tick; pollNew5m is not called, no candle is processed, no EQ/FVG/WATCH state advances and no notification is emitted for that tick
